name: Desktop sidebar follows Default Chats
author: wizard
description: On the AI apps desktop, the chats sidebar on the left shows the Chats look you picked under Settings › Chats › Default Chats (for example Telegram Style), like phones and the Classic desktop already do. A chat you tap there opens in the main chat. With built-in Wizard Chats picked nothing changes, and if the other look fails to load the sidebar goes back to built-in Chats (wizard-ux issue 1443).
